modalities.evidence: MRI and behavioral data from 318 participants

output.population: 318 participants, all with at least a quantitative T1-weighted image and a 15-minute eyes-open resting-state session; subsets took part in the LEMON and/or Neuroanatomy & Connectivity protocols
output.summary: MRI and behavioral data from participants in two protocols: LEMON, focused on structural imaging with T1, T2, diffusion, FLAIR and gradient-echo scans, and a Neuroanatomy & Connectivity protocol focused on resting-state fMRI.
